lines_of_business: Excellus BlueCross BlueShield (not otherwise specified in criteria)
effective_or_revised: Current Effective Date July 16, 2026; Next Review July 2027
criteria_location: Policy Statement II/III (pp.1-4) plus Policy Guidelines I-V (pp.4-10), including a condition table (Pressure / Patient Selection Criteria / Duration / Utilization review) and CMS provider requirements.

logic.top_level: pathways (18 covered indications II.A-R, each with condition-specific table row; plus general documentation rules)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Investigational list III.A-RR 'for ALL other indications'; Wagner 5 / complete gangrene in documentation note.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Policy Guideline III: 'Continued treatment with HBOT is not covered if measurable signs of healing have not been demonstrated within any 30-day period of treatment. Most patients should NOT require more than 40 treatments.' Utilization review column per condition.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: ALL the following: ... 3. No measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy; which may include ANY of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'may include ANY' makes the standard-therapy components optional and unverifiable

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Treatment is recommended either: combined with steroid therapy within 2 weeks of onset; or ... salvage within 1 month
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Appears in table 'Patient Selection Criteria', not in Policy Statement, so unclear if binding

No measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy
optimization of glucose control; debridement by any means; appropriate off-loading

Weekly wound measurements should be performed
advanced diabetic foot ulcers may require photos

Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) training and certification of supervising physicians
physician (or qualified NPP) must be present in the office suite or at a location with a maximum of a five-minute response time
The degree of hearing loss is typically defined as a loss of 30 decibels or more across 3 contiguous frequencies
tissue oxygen tension is below 30 mmHg
Within six hours of patient removal from the carbon monoxide-contaminated environment

external_dependencies.what: CMS provider criteria for HBOT supervision
external_dependencies.quote: It is recommended that the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) criteria for coverage be utilized in determining appropriate practitioners to render HBOT.

interesting_structures: Per-condition table giving ATA, patient selection criteria, session counts, and utilization-review checkpoint
Provider supervision and ACLS rules borrowed from CMS

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs
fit_to_tree.why: Core indications fit any-of, but condition-specific table rows add guideline-level selection criteria, session counts and review checkpoints, with 'should' language that is not clearly binding.
